params._escrowAmount: Amount of USDC escrowed by party A
params._evidenceDeadlineSeconds: Seconds after dispute for evidence submission window
params._evidenceDefs: What types of evidence each side can submit
params._guidelines: Instructions for how the AI jury should evaluate the statement
params._joinDeadline: Timestamp by which party B must accept (0 = no deadline)
params._maxEvidenceLength: Maximum length of evidence in bytes (0 = no limit)
params._statement: The claim to be evaluated as true/false
params._usdcToken: Address of the USDC token contract

returns._0: keccak256 of a versioned type string, e.g.          keccak256("AGENT_DISPUTE_V1") or keccak256("TRADE_FINANCE_V1")

params.statementIsTrue: true = statement is TRUE, false = statement is FALSE

params.evidence: The evidence string (content depends on evidenceDefs)

ORACLE_TYPE().notice: Oracle type for agent disputes. Relay deploys case_resolution.py.

acceptAgreement().notice: Party B accepts the agreement. No deposit required.

cancel().notice: Cancel the agreement before party B has accepted.         Returns party A's USDC escrow deposit.

cancelInactive().notice: Cancel an ACTIVE agreement that has been inactive for INACTIVITY_TIMEOUT.         Returns escrow to party A. Anyone can call.

claimFunds().notice: Withdraw pending USDC funds after resolution. Pull-based pattern prevents         a reverting recipient from blocking the other party's withdrawal.

closeEvidenceWindow().notice: Close the evidence window and trigger resolution after the deadline.         Anyone can call this once the evidence deadline has passed.

confirmOutcome().notice: Confirm the other party's proposed outcome. Shorthand for proposing the same outcome.         Only callable if the other party has already proposed.

constructor.notice: Deploy a new agreement. The factory handles USDC transfer before deployment.

getOracleArgs().notice: Returns ABI-encoded constructor args for case_resolution.py:         (agreement_address, statement, guidelines, evidence_a, evidence_b,          evidence_defs, bridge_sender, target_chain_eid, target_contract)         bridge_sender and target_chain_eid are injected by the relay from         its own config; they are not stored on-chain. The relay appends them         after decoding this payload. Encoded here: address + 6 strings.

getOracleType().notice: Oracle type identifier. The relay uses this to look up which         GenLayer oracle to deploy and how to decode getOracleArgs().

proposeOutcome(bool).notice: Propose an outcome. If both parties propose the same outcome, the agreement resolves.

raiseDispute().notice: Raise a dispute. Opens the evidence submission window.         Can be called by either party when the agreement is ACTIVE.

reclaimOnExpiry().notice: Reclaim escrowed USDC after the join deadline has expired without party B accepting.         Anyone can call this to trigger the reclaim.

resolveByDefault().notice: Resolve by default judgment after evidence deadline passes.         Neither party submitted → UNDETERMINED; only initiator submitted → initiator wins;         only non-initiator submitted → non-initiator wins.

setResolution(uint8,string).notice: Set the resolution verdict. Only callable by the factory (via bridge).

submitEvidence(string).notice: Submit evidence. Each party can submit once during the evidence window.
